WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text and SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing: text containers grow with their content. Fixed heights clip tall scripts at segmented_control.css:17 (28px), status_bar.css:4 (36px), language_dropdown.css:10 (36px) and folder_row.css:4 (36px) (Phase 73 D-21 #9); v5.1 changes them to min-height.

The accent is set at runtime from the OS (ACCENT_COLOR_FALLBACK at src/domain/accent_color.ts:4 is only the Linux fallback), so the contrast test covers the fallback accent only. User-chosen system accents such as yellow and graphite can fall below 3:1 against a ground and cannot be proven statically; no ratio is quoted for them because no accent hex is named to measure (D-07).

The fallback accent ring directly on a raised Tide surface measures 2.86:1, below the 3:1 of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11; on the Deep Teal ground it measures 3.63:1. v5.1 therefore offsets the dark ring 2 px onto the Deep Teal ground and never draws it directly on Tide; 74-04's proposed set checks the ground-adjacent pair. This is a spec value, not a sealed contrast-gap entry, because today's focus pairs all pass.

The reveal button has no ring rule of its own: its :focus-visible rule only raises opacity to 1 (file_table.css:161-164), unlike the other focusable controls in styles/, which draw the 2px accent outline. v5.1 adds the same ring so the reveal button's focus indicator is the specified one (SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
The ring uses the platform accent token, set at runtime from systemPreferences.getAccentColor() (D-04); it is the same colour as ::selection and the toggle-on track.
Forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) mode removes box-shadow, so a ring built from it disappears for the people who need it most; an outline is kept and recoloured.
D-12: a free-standing control (button, toggle, segmented control, link) keeps its ring 2 px outside, as every focus-visible rule in styles/ does today (outline-offset: 2px).

R-09: an outset ring on a full-width row inside .file-table__body (overflow-y: auto, file_table.css:57-59) is clipped on the left, right and first-row top; only the bottom edge draws. .file-table__row already declares outline-offset: -2px (file_table.css:70) and its :focus-visible rule overrides it to +2px at :83; menu items clip the same way. Measured in Playwright's bundled Chromium on copied rules (assumption A4), not Electron 44.
A solid CSS outline, never box-shadow or border: outlines are drawn on top of neighbours and kept by forced-colors mode, which drops box-shadow (D-12).
D-12: the ring shows on :focus-visible only, so a mouse click does not draw it while keyboard focus always does (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible).

darkRinse.value: pill fill becomes the ground colour on hovered, pressed and selected rows

app.reason: A Rinse pill on a Rinse hover has no visible fill, and in dark a Tide pill on a Tide hover has none (the same colour twice). On a hovered, pressed or selected row the type pill fill therefore becomes the ground colour: Clean White in light, Deep Teal in dark. Pill text keeps its contrast on both fills: Deep Teal on Rinse 13.30:1 and on Clean White 14.59:1; Fog on Tide 6.48:1 and on Deep Teal 8.22:1 (floored). The pill boundary is not a required non-text contrast, because the label text carries the meaning, so WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 applies to the text here.

D-06: pressed is the hover surface under the state overlay: Tide #12403C under Clean White at alpha 0.12 flattens to #2E5753 (gamma-encoded, Math.round per channel). No transform. Clean White text on it measures 8.06:1, Fog 4.54:1 and the cleaned colour Seafoam 5.45:1 (floored), all above 4.5:1.

D-06: pressed is the hover surface under the state overlay: Rinse #EEF6F5 under Deep Teal at alpha 0.08 flattens to #DCE6E5 (gamma-encoded, Math.round per channel). No transform. Deep Teal text on it measures 11.46:1 and Pewter 5.14:1, but the cleaned colour Steady Teal measures 4.29:1 (floored), below the 4.5:1 of SC 1.4.3 for text, so a pressed row's after-count takes the primary text colour while it is pressed (table-row pressed, light).
